description: First version of the Code of Conduct
Added anti-bribery clause and whistleblower channel
Added moonlighting rules and conflict-of-interest declaration
Gift declaration limit raised from INR 2,000 to INR 3,000
Hybrid model introduced: 3 days in office per week
Web clock-in and clock-out through ZenPeople for remote days
Full-WFO groups clarified (induction, notice period, unallocated staff)
Added Austin Regional Supplement and meeting etiquette
Paternity leave raised from 5 to 10 working days; volunteer days added
Sabbatical clause and clarified EL encashment
Added PIP timeline and appeal route
Added links to POSH and Information Security policies
Rules for AI tools and personal devices added
Added night-shift transport and ergonomic assessment for hybrid work
First POSH policy and Internal Committee constituted
Updated committee members and contact details
Data governance rules from Project Beacon
Responsible AI section added for Sage
Performance and AI evaluation gates added
Leaver access removal tightened to 4 hours
